name: M3_PMS100MI_Reschedule
description: Reschedule an existing manufacturing order by updating its planned dates, times, quantity and priority at header level. This request recalculates the order’s timing using either infinite or finite capacity planning and can optionally propagate changes to lower‑level orders created by explosion. It can also maintain manual expiration and reclassification dates for lot‑controlled items so that shelf‑life and reclassification follow the new plan. No data is returned; the operation only updates the identified manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order to be rescheduled is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the item on the manufacturing order to be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number identifying the order to be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: WLDE
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order is rescheduled using finite or infinite capacity planning.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number that owns the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: New planned start date for the manufacturing order when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: FIDT
inputParameters.description: New planned finish date for the manufacturing order when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: PRIO
inputParameters.description: Updated priority of the manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

inputParameters.name: DSP1
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge date-related warnings when rescheduling the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP2
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge additional rescheduling warnings related to start date or order connections.

inputParameters.name: DSP3
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge warnings about finish date or subcontracted content when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: DSP4
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge quantity-related warnings when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: DSP5
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge warnings about previous rescheduling or alternate routing when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: DSP6
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge warnings about started operations or order multiples when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: DSP7
inputParameters.description: Additional warning indicator used to acknowledge specific system warnings during rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: DSP8
inputParameters.description: Warning indicator used to acknowledge warnings that operations have already been started when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: MEXP
inputParameters.description: Manual expiration date for the manufactured item or lot, overriding any system-calculated expiry if used.

inputParameters.name: MSTI
inputParameters.description: New planned start time for the manufacturing order when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: MFTI
inputParameters.description: New planned finish time for the manufacturing order when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: RPLL
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether lower-level orders created from the manufacturing order should also be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: MREC
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification date specifying when the manufactured items may be reclassified between quality statuses.

inputParameters.name: MRCT
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification time specifying when on the reclassification date the status change may occur.
